user.title: Connect to your Vitrea V-Box
user.description: Uses the V-Box's mobile (app) protocol. Pick a mobile account slot (vitrea1-vitrea8) that no phone is currently using.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect or log in. Check the IP, port, account and password, and that no other device is logged in with this account.

data_description.disable_metadata_cache: Skip the metadata cache. Turn on, click Reload, then turn off again to force a one-off rescan.
data_description.excluded_keys: Comma-separated node:key pairs (0-indexed) to skip, e.g. 12:3,40:0
